name: Preecursor | Save and qualify an inquiry

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO preecursor.leads (submission_id, payload, priority)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::jsonb, $3)
ON CONFLICT (submission_id) DO UPDATE SET submission_id = EXCLUDED.submission_id
WHERE preecursor.leads.payload = EXCLUDED.payload
RETURNING submission_id::text AS "submissionId";

parameters.responseBody: ={{ $json.submissionId ? { accepted: true, submissionId: $json.submissionId } : { accepted: false, error: 'Conflicting submission. Please reload and retry.' } }}
={{ { accepted: false, error: 'Unable to save inquiry. Please retry.' } }}
